description: Source file implementing functions to validate desktop OpenGL formats, types, and their combinations within the ANGLE project.

methods.name: ValidDesktopFormat
methods.description: Checks if a given GLenum format is a valid desktop format.

methods.name: ValidDesktopType
methods.description: Checks if a given GLenum type is a valid desktop type.

methods.name: ValidDesktopFormatCombination
methods.description: Validates if a combination of format, type, and internalFormat is valid according to OpenGL 4.6 spec.
